entities.summary: Oil Wealth and Independence, a transformative movement in Kuwait (1946–1961). Emerged from Oil discovered at Burgan field — one of the world's largest and First commercial oil export from Kuwait. Catalyzed Kuwait gains independence from Britain and Iraq immediately claims Kuwait; British troops deter invasion.
